menstruacna.name: Menstrual phase
menstruacna.description: You're in your inner winter. The body goes quiet and asks for rest — like nature in January. It's not weakness, it's the body's wisdom: only do as much as you feel up to.

folikularna.name: Follicular phase
folikularna.description: You're entering your inner spring. Hormones are waking up, your head clears, and the urge to create grows with each day — a great time for new challenges, strength training and longer runs.

ovulacia.name: Ovulation
ovulacia.description: You're in your inner summer. The sun is at its highest — energy, confidence and the urge to be around people are all at their peak — time for personal records and community activities.

lutealna.name: Luteal phase
lutealna.description: You're entering your inner autumn. Energy slowly quiets down and your body invites you to harvest — finish what you started, and choose gentler movement: yoga, walks, recovery.

menstruacna_tazke_dni.name: Winter — the deepest dark
menstruacna_tazke_dni.description: The first days tend to be the hardest, just like the shortest days of the year. Energy is at its lowest, so let yourself stop — warmth, calm, and nothing to prove.

menstruacna_doznievanie.name: Winter — the light is returning
menstruacna_doznievanie.description: Bleeding is easing, strength is slowly coming back, as if the days were growing a little longer again. If you feel like moving, pick a short walk, but don't push yourself.

folikularna_rozbeh.name: Spring — the first buds
folikularna_rozbeh.description: Hormones are rising and your head clears, as if the first buds were sprouting from the ground. A great time to launch new ideas and plans.

folikularna_vrchol.name: Spring — full bloom
folikularna_vrchol.description: You're in great shape — energy, self-confidence and performance are growing as fast as spring greenery. Your body can handle more demanding training now.

ovulacia.name: Summer — full sun
ovulacia.description: You're at the peak of your cycle, just like the sun on the longest day of the year. Energy, confidence and the urge to be around people are all at their highest — time for personal records.

lutealna_stabilna.name: Autumn — harvest time
lutealna_stabilna.description: Energy is still good, just slowly settling, like warm September days. Finish what you've started while you still have the strength for it.

lutealna_premenliva.name: Autumn — the wind is changing
lutealna_premenliva.description: Moods can shift and you're more sensitive, much like autumn weather changing. Be patient with yourself and don't plan anything demanding for these days.

lutealna_neskora.name: Autumn — the last leaves fall
lutealna_neskora.description: Energy is at its lowest and PMS is at its strongest, right before calm winter arrives. Give yourself rest, gentleness and as few obligations as possible.

ovulacia.mantra: I am out in the world.

menstruacna.tagline: The cycle's inner winter — time to let go and go quiet.

folikularna.tagline: The cycle's inner spring — time to sprout and begin.

ovulacia.tagline: The cycle's inner summer — time to shine and connect.

lutealna.tagline: The cycle's inner autumn — time to harvest and slow down.

tips.Masírovanie hrádze, ak sa cítiš priprave: Perineal massage, if you feel ready
tips.Menej alkoholu, kofeín do 1–2 káv denne: Less alcohol, caffeine down to 1–2 coffees a day
tips.Nemusíš jesť za dvoch: You don't have to eat for two
tips.Pi, aj keď nemáš chuť jesť: Drink, even when you don't feel like eating
tips.Predpôrodné kurzy, pokojne aj s partnero: Prenatal classes, with your partner too
tips.Prenatálne vitamíny podľa lekárky: Prenatal vitamins as advised by your doctor
tips.Píš si vďačnosť: Write down what you're grateful for
tips.Sedací kúpeľ s harmančekom a nechtíkom: Sitz bath with chamomile and calendula
tips.Suché sušienky hneď ráno: Dry crackers first thing in the morning
tips.Veľa vody, najmä pri dojčení: Plenty of water, especially while breastfeeding
tips.Zapoj partnera do príprav: Involve your partner in the preparations
tips.Zdravá váha a mierny pohyb: A healthy weight and moderate movement
tips.Zvažuj dulu k pôrodu: Consider a doula for the birth
tips.Ľahká chôdza, ak vládzeš: Easy walking, if you're up for it
